instruction.front: Hair dry and styled as usual. Fit your face in the oval with your hairline near the top.
instruction.left: Turn to show your left side. Keep the phone upright at eye level.
instruction.right: Turn to show your right side. Keep the phone upright at eye level.
instruction.top: Hold the phone flat above your head, screen up, so the back camera looks down at the top of your head.
instruction.crown: Hold the phone flat above the back of your head, screen up, so the back camera looks down at your crown.

cameraNote.front: Uses the front camera so you can see the frame.
cameraNote.back: Uses the back camera. Hold the phone flat, or ask someone to take it. You feel a tap when it is level.

guide.frame: Camera view with a framing guide

level.flat: Hold the phone flat, screen up
level.unavailable: This device has no motion sensor, so the level check is off. Make sure the phone is upright yourself.
level.a11yOk: The phone is level. You can take the photo.
level.a11yBlockedUpright: The phone is not upright yet.
level.a11yBlockedFlat: The phone is not flat yet.

shutter.label: Take photo
shutter.blockedUpright: Hold your phone upright to take the photo
shutter.blockedFlat: Hold your phone flat to take the photo

permission.title: Camera access is off
permission.body: Kök uses the camera only for your progress photos. They stay on this device. You can also pick a photo from your library.
